description: Aménagements cyclables de Haut-Léon Communauté is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Haut-Léon Communauté. Aménagements cyclables de Haut-Léon Communauté, selon le standard CNIG, relevé en juin 2026. Il comporte des données sur les infrastructures linéaires cyclables. Haut-Léon Communauté publie également des données sur les stationnement cyclables. Coverage: Haut-Léon Communauté. The publisher named on the listing is Haut-Léon Communauté. Its keywords include voies-cyclables, partage-mode, mobilite-durable, equipement, infrastructure-pietonne-et-cyclable, equipement-public. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
